finalText:
De-duplication is in. `createState()` now returns a `lastSentAt` map from key to the minute of the last delivery.

Replay results:
- dropped: 99, errors: 0
- every other count fell by the same repeats: pager 225 → 200, queue 300 → 266

The 99 drops match the flaps in `events.js`, which fire the same key two minutes after the last one. No other event pair shares a key inside 5 minutes.

Three decisions in the code:
- The window is strict: a repeat drops when the gap is under 5 minutes. A gap of exactly 5 minutes delivers.
- The router records the time only when it delivers. A dropped repeat does not extend the window, so a flap storm cannot silence a key forever.
- `at` does not always increase across the replay, so the check uses the absolute gap. Two events 3 minutes apart de-duplicate in either order.
